description: A unit of execution started with start and awaited with join, which runs alongside the main thread.
An object that owns threads and runs submitted tasks, closed with try-with-resources.
A handle to a pending result whose get method blocks and rethrows a task failure as ExecutionException.
A future that chains steps with thenApply and thenCombine and reports failures as CompletionException.
A lightweight JDK-managed thread that releases its operating system thread while blocked, suited to tasks that mostly wait.
A bug where the result depends on how threads interleave, such as lost updates on a shared counter.
A keyword that lets one thread at a time run a method or block, protecting shared mutable state.
A class such as AtomicInteger whose operations like incrementAndGet are safe across threads without a lock.
